result.topic_en: Very faint, mirror-image ink (apparently bleed-through from the other side of the sheet) showing what look like formulas from potential theory: multiple integrals in polar or spherical coordinates and a distance expression of the form r = sqrt((x-α)^2+(y-β)^2+(z-γ)^2).
result.transcription:
[The writing on this page appears as faint mirror-image show-through from the reverse side; the readings below are tentative.]

$\frac{1}{\cdots}\left(\frac{\cdots}{\cdots}\right)^{\cdots}$ [?] $\cdots$ $\varphi(x,y,z)$ [?] $\cdots$

$x = \rho\cos\vartheta$ [?]
$y = \rho\sin\vartheta\cos\varphi$ [?]
$z = \rho\sin\vartheta\sin\varphi$ [?]

$\chi(x) = \frac{1}{\pi}\int_0^{\cdots}\cdots\chi(\cdots)\cdots$ [?]

$\int_0^\infty\int_0^\pi\int_0^{2\pi}\cdots\cos\cdots\, \rho^2\sin\vartheta\, d\rho\, d\vartheta\, d\varphi$ [?]

$r = \sqrt{(x-\alpha)^2+(y-\beta)^2+(z-\gamma)^2}$ [?]

$\int_0^\pi f(\cos\cdots)\sin\cdots\, d\cdots$ [?]

$2\pi\int_0^\pi f(\cos\cdots)\sin\cdots = \cdots(\cdots)$ [?]

$\frac{1}{\cdots}\iiint\frac{\cdots}{\sqrt{(x-\alpha)^2+(y-\beta)^2+(z-\gamma)^2}}\,\varphi(\alpha,\beta,\gamma)\,d\alpha\,d\beta\,d\gamma$ [?]

$\alpha = x + \rho\cos\vartheta$ [?]
$\beta = y + \rho\sin\vartheta\cos\varphi$ [?]
$\gamma = z + \rho\sin\vartheta\sin\varphi$ [?]
